findings.title: Reflected XSS via name parameter
findings.description: The 'name' GET parameter on /page is vulnerable to reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). The parameter is reflected in the HTML response within an input value attribute. By breaking out of the attribute with '"' and injecting an tag with an onerror event handler, JavaScript execution is achieved. The application filters direct script tags and some event handler content, but String.fromCharCode() bypasses the filter.

reproduction.expected: XSS alert with 'XSS' text and flag displayed in response
